card.name: Optics and camera text, small linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words or number pieces inside passages about eyesight, retina, lenses and cameras, such as 'the' before retina or 'mp' after 36.

modes.label: Eye optics

modes.label: Digits in years

card.writes: No clear meaning; it weakly suppresses 'mirror' words, so it may steer away from mirror in optics text.
card.plain: It fires on little words in texts about eyes, lenses and cameras, where the next word is not likely to be 'mirror'.
